notes: Static contract validation is not a Studio live pass.
Candidate identity and runner_isolation bind runtime target, runtime digest, source revision, isolated producer workflow, exact readable input closure, privacy scan, and cleanup state.
User confirmation binds the case_id, exact room_refs, and the single materialized plan owner through one user transcript event.
Every create_thread event must cite explicit user confirmation and one room from that confirmed set.
Every writer must use a worktree whose effective revision matches the task-card source revision.
Every writer must declare a reviewed return contract before creation.
Git return methods require a separate user authorization event.
fork_thread, handoff_thread, and set_thread_archived require separate user authorization.
send_message_to_thread uses the real prompt field and stays inside the confirmed room scope.
wait_threads evidence uses the real targets[].afterCursor request and wake plus polls[] plus errors[] response shape.
Every tool event declares the fixed effect for the real Codex operation.
director_trace_scope is host_and_transcript_events; non-host local, subagent, and Cursor omission is explicitly not proven by this evaluator.
Every terminal room result is handled before unrelated recorded work; every rework phase waits again with an advancing changed poll.
Writer return and integration events bind to successful host gate events and independent review evidence.
Negative and unresolved cases must contain zero create_thread calls.
An independent judge identity and raw case digest bind reviewed cases to the direct raw result path.
